hooks.text: 精准、火力、灵能和战士四类英雄拥有不同普攻与终极技能，并可叠加改造英雄与神器。
hooks.excerpt: Deploy four types of heroes - Precision, Firepower, Psionic, and Warrior. Each hero possesses unique basic attacks and ultimate skills. Combine with modified heroes and artifacts to create your ultimate defense line.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每局随机掉落英雄、装备与“银河原则”，所有选择都会改变当前防线。
hooks.excerpt: Each game randomly drops heroes, equipment, and 'Galactic Principles'. Every choice will affect the battle situation, providing infinite replay value.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 火、毒、雷、冰等异常可组合触发爆炸、灵魂分离与瘴气等复合效果。
hooks.excerpt: Combine elemental abnormalities such as fire, poison, lightning, ice, etc., to trigger compound effects like explosions, soul separation, miasma, etc., with progressively deeper strategic layers.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 加载动画中的小怪兽互动很可爱。
